title: Person harmed when the gauntlet object was retrieved
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: got brought up that uh that somebody was potentially harmed in the retrieval of that item

plain: Someone may have been hurt while recovering an unusual object he calls "the gauntlet", according to Randy Anderson, a man who says he saw what he believed was alien technology at a military base, the Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane in Indiana, around 2014. Anderson says this came up while he was there; he does not say he saw the harm himself, only that "somebody was potentially harmed in the retrieval of that item". If true, it would mean the object was dangerous to handle.
